config.compose: docker/docker-compose.yml (postgres + redis only; CMS via pnpm tsx src/serve.ts)
config.LUMIBASE_DELIVER_RATE_LIMIT: 0 (disabled for DB-query sample; see rate-limit probe)

results.method: pg_stat_user_tables scans on lumibase_pages minus 200-path selects; cross-checked with lumibase_cache_negative_writes_total delta / 404 count

rate_limit_probe.note: Single-IP 50 RPS (~3000/min) trips the 1200/min budget after ~24s. Default 1200 kept as anti-abuse floor.
